questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

13 : 169 :: 21 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Logic: (First number)² = Second number**

 
• 13 : 169 → 13² = 169

Similarly,

 
• 21 : ? → **21² = 441**

Hence, the correct answer is **"441".**

questions.question: In a row, Manu is at 14th position from the left and Sam is at the 9th position from the right. If they interchange their positions, then Sam becomes 12th from the right. Find the total number of persons present in the row.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

In a row, Manu is at 14th position from the left and Sam is at the 9th position from the right. If they interchange their positions, then Sam becomes 12th from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bfa17c8658f7ffb88f4c88cd224e9b4c149aca6ff06b79e9d0a62d5d87a5b14.png] 

Total number of person in a row = 14 + 12 - 1

Total number of persons in a row = 26 - 1

∴ Total number of persons in a row = 25

Hence, the correct answer is **"25".**

questions.question: Three persons A, B and C start a business with a total amount of ₹2,60,000. The ratio of their investment in the total amount is 15 : 18 : 19, respectively. They earn a profit of 12% this year on the total investment. The profit is to be distributed in the same ratio of investment. How much profit will C earn?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A, B, and C start a business with a total amount of = 2,60,000/-

The ratio of their investment in the total amount = 15 : 18 : 19

They earn a profit of 12% this year on the total investment

**Calculation:**

Total parts of ratio of their investment = 15 + 18 + 19 = 52

Since they earn a profit of 12% this year on the total investment.

Profit amount = 260000 × 12/100 = 31200/-

Share of C in this profit = (19)/(15+18+19)×31200 &nb
sp;

**∴ ****Share of C in this profit = 11,400/-**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

 _ P G _ _ M P _ _ A _ _ G F A
questions.solution:
Given :- _ P G _ _ M P _ _ A _ _ G F A

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) MFAGMFP → **M** P G **F A** - M P **G M** A - **F**** P** G F A

2) MFAGFMP → **M** P G **F A** - M P **G F** A - **M P** G F A

 
• Here **"MPGFA"** is repeated.

3) MAGFMPF → **M** P G **A G** - M P **F M** A - **P F** G F A

4) MFAFGMP → **M** P G **F A - **M P **F G** A - **M P** G F A

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- "M P G F A - M P G F A - M P G F A".

Hence, the correct answer is **"MFAGFMP".**

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some Queens are kings.

All kings are officers.

No officer is architect.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some officers are queens.

II. No king is architect.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/329d1a4d606cefaa558be9597af771346698620f0fce4a5d98ecf57c85b71167.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some officers are queens → Follow (As All kings are officers and Some Queens are kings so, Some officers are queens is true)

II. No king is architect → Follow (As All kings are officers and No officer is architect so, No king is architect is true)

∴ Here, Both the conclusions are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both the conclusions follow".**
